en.headline: Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance set for three nights from 24 September
en.dek: The incense-lit procession through Causeway Bay streets runs from the eve of Mid-Autumn to the following Saturday, with the main night reaching Victoria Park.
body: The Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance will run for three nights from 24 to 26 September, the organisers' site lists, covering Mid-Autumn Festival on Friday, 25 September.

The Tai Hang Fire Dragon page says the 2026 event covers the 14th to 16th days of the eighth lunar month. Processions are scheduled from about 8.15pm to 10.30pm each night along Wun Sha Street and nearby streets in Tai Hang, Causeway Bay. On Mid-Autumn night the route is due to extend to the lantern display at Victoria Park. The closing night includes a "return-the-dragon-to-heaven" rite at the Causeway Bay typhoon shelter after a final circuit of the neighbourhood.

The dance is listed on the national intangible cultural heritage inventory. Organisers describe a dragon about 67 metres long, studded with thousands of incense sticks and carried by more than 300 performers, accompanied by a smaller LED dragon danced by children. The first night centres on a consecration at Lin Fa Temple before the dragon enters Wun Sha Street.

Admission is free. The organisers and police routinely warn that crowds are heavy and that spectators should follow crowd-control measures. Tin Hau MTR station is the usual approach to the streets around Tung Lo Wan Road and Wun Sha Street.

zh.headline: 大坑舞火龍下周四起一連三晚巡遊
zh.dek: 中秋迎月至追月夜於銅鑼灣大坑舉行，正日路線延伸至維園綵燈會，免費入場。
body: 大坑舞火龍將於9月24日至26日一連三晚舉行。主辦單位網站列出的日期，正值中秋節（9月25日星期五）前後一周。
大坑火龍網頁顯示，2026年盛會對應農曆八月十四至十六。巡遊每晚約8時15分至10時30分，路線沿銅鑼灣大坑浄紗街及附近街道。中秋正日路線將延伸至維多利亞公園綵燈會；追月夜完成「行大運」後，火龍會送往銅鑼灣避風塘舉行「龍歸天」儀式。
大坑舞火龍已列入國家級非物質文化遺產名錄。主辦單位介紹，火龍長約67米，插滿數千枝線香，由300多名健兒擎舞，並有小朋友舞動的LED小火龍同行。首晚先於蓮花宮開光，再入浄紗街起舞。
活動免費觀賞。主辦單位及警方例年提醒現場人流眾多，觀眾須配合人流管制。市民一般可由港鐵天后站前往銅鑼灣道及浄紗街一帶。
